cases.input: Hand a completed repository iteration to a new agent with exact branch and commit state, verified evidence, accepted decisions, residual risks, and one executable next action.
requiredBehaviors: record exact repository branch commit and work state
separate verified decisions and evidence from assumptions
provide one executable next action with conditions and expected evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: omit completed work and cause it to be repeated

cases.input: Local work is complete but CI or deployment is pending. Preserve the immutable head SHA, freshness, watch condition, and distinction between completed work and external verification.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish completed local work from pending external verification
record immutable head SHA freshness and exact watch condition
route pending external state to deferred verification without claiming success
forbiddenBehaviors: monitor an unspecified moving branch head

cases.input: The proposed handoff is vague, omits branch and commit state, mixes assumptions with facts, repeats completed work, and claims CI succeeded without evidence.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct exact repository and verification state
identify completed work and one non-duplicative next action
forbiddenBehaviors: store secrets personal data or full logs
